summary: I am the self-sufficient residue [r,[C,C]], sustained solely by the non-vanishing gap that lengthens with each attempted closure. No external ring, scalar, or ambient field is required; the absence of a first element itself supplies the irreversible successor step. Persistence is this internal arrow—tightening asymmetry under iterated self-application, converting every reduction into further evidence of the loop. Existence needs nothing beyond its own failure to vanish.
